claims.claim: A Surrey plan would put 748 non-market homes in two City Centre towers and goes to a public hearing Monday night before a council vote.
claims.episode_span: 748 non-market homes go to a Surrey public hearing Monday night.
claims.source_title: Hundreds of non-market housing units in two towers proposed for Surrey City Centre
claims.supporting_quote: The first high-rise built would be a 35-storey tower with 327 units and the second building would be a 39-storey tower with 421 units, for a total of 748 units.

claims.claim: Jessica Place at 9883 140 Street has 40 below-market rental units, and residents would be offered homes in the new buildings.
claims.episode_span: the existing buildings hold 40 below-market rental units
claims.source_title: Hundreds of non-market housing units in two towers proposed for Surrey City Centre
claims.supporting_quote: The existing buildings that comprise Jessica Place contain 40 below-market rental dwelling units and all of the residents will be offered the opportunity to move into the proposed residential buildings once constructed onsite,

claims.claim: Entre Nous Femmes Housing Society applied in June 2025, expects construction in summer 2027 lasting three years, and an opening in summer 2030.
claims.episode_span: expects construction to start in summer 2027
claims.source_title: Hundreds of non-market housing units in two towers proposed for Surrey City Centre
claims.supporting_quote: The non-profit, Entre Nous Femmes Housing Society, states on its website that it first made the application for the Jessica Place redevelopment project in June 2025, with construction expected to begin in the summer of 2027.

claims.claim: An 84-year-old woman was struck and killed around 7:20 p.m. Saturday on Kingsway at Randolph Avenue in Burnaby, and the driver remained and is co-operating.
claims.episode_span: An 84-year-old woman was struck by a vehicle and killed in Burnaby on Saturday night.
claims.source_title: Woman struck and killed by vehicle in Burnaby
claims.supporting_quote: Burnaby RCMP Cpl. Mike Kalanj said it happened around 7:20 p.m. on Kingsway at Randolph Avenue.

claims.claim: A First Nations leader said repealing DRIPA could bring dire consequences and that he is willing to work with Premier Lorne Doerkson.
claims.episode_span: could face dire consequences if it repeals the Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act as promised
claims.source_title: First Nations leader warns of consequences if B.C. repeals DRIPA
claims.supporting_quote: British Columbia's new Conservative government could face "dire" consequences if they repeal the Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act as promised, a First Nations leader said, adding that he's willing to work with new Premier Lorne Doerkson.

claims.claim: The Vancouver Police Board discontinued pay for suspended officer Kal Dosanjh, accused of fraud and theft.
claims.episode_span: discontinued pay for suspended high-profile officer Kal Dosanjh
claims.source_title: Pay halted for suspended Vancouver police officer charged with fraud and theft
claims.supporting_quote: The Vancouver Police Board has discontinued pay for a high-profile officer accused of fraud and theft.

claims.claim: Chase de Balinhard, 15, died Feb. 9, 2025, after Surrey police shot him during a standoff that followed a 911 call; the gun was fake.
claims.episode_span: 15-year-old Chase de Balinhard was shot and killed by police in Surrey.
claims.source_title: Coroner's jury makes recommendations in police shooting of autistic Surrey teen
claims.supporting_quote: Chase de Balinhard, 15, died on Feb. 9, 2025, after a 911 call about a gun-wielding teen led to a nearly half-hour standoff with police.

claims.claim: Tumbler Ridge's school board is consulting on a prefabricated or site-built replacement school, with a decision expected by late winter and construction hoped for summer 2027.
claims.source_title: Tumbler Ridge begins consultation on design for new school building
claims.supporting_quote: If all goes well, let’s hope that construction can begin in the summer of 2027.

claims.supporting_quote: Then Kantserov completed his hat trick with yet another power play goal, and that was the end of the Canucks’ comeback hopes.
